description:
Ju-Won Kim is somewhat satisfied with his life despite his position as a temp worker after barely making it out of a diploma mill. He's been keeping his sexuality as a gay man his top secret ever since he discovered his sexual preference in his teenage years. Independently, he runs into Gang-Hyeok at his favourite bar one weekend. Gang-Hyeok Choi, the general headquarters manager of a conglomerate, is a perfect man with an outstanding appearance, business mind, manners, and class. Ju-Won, thinking Gang-Hyeok would never find out who he is, ends up having a one-nighter... "Is this emotion right now... some sort of love...?" "This is a flame that will go off sooner or later, just a passion and lust, not love." Game-of-tag romance between Gang-Hyeok, who thinks it's love, and Ju-Won, who says it's a delusion, begins.

(Source: NETCOMICS)
